skills.name: pega-companion
skills.description: Entry point for any Pega Infinity graph/log/diagnostic question -- Neo4j-grounded impact analysis, code review, log RCA, per-app knowledge, Constellation migration. Read-only; every fix terminates in the Rule Authoring plugin's ChangeRequest workflow, never a direct write.

skills.name: pega-companion-seam
skills.description: The Companion -- Rule Authoring seam -- orchestrates a proposed Pega change across the ChangeRequest lifecycle (intake -> authoring -> review -> complete), injecting a blast-radius/Impact Analysis report before human approval.

skills.name: pega-impact-analysis
skills.description: Proactive enterprise-wide impact analysis for a proposed rule change -- what breaks, who's affected, what must be done -- BEFORE the change is made. 3-hop blast radius, deterministic risk rubric.

skills.name: pega-log-diagnosis
skills.description: Diagnoses a Pega production error end-to-end from a log excerpt/stack trace/class hash -- root cause, point of failure, technical blast radius, and business-process impact grounded in Feature nodes.

skills.name: pega-code-review
skills.description: Formal pre-promotion code review for a Pega rule/branch -- mandatory graph investigation (G1-G4), PASS/WARN/FAIL verdict, per-rule-type defect checklists, schema-validated against the Rule Authoring plugin's JSON schemas.

skills.name: pega-neo4j-cypher-querying
skills.description: Writes correct Cypher against the PDS Neo4j knowledge graph -- environment landmine, node/relationship schema, ref_category taxonomy, and a recipe library for blast radius, root-to-leaf tree, rule disambiguation, class hierarchy, ruleset stack.

skills.name: pega-feature-node-retrieval
skills.description: Answers business/functional questions about a Pega case type, queue processor, or job scheduler by retrieving its Feature node from Neo4j -- existence check first, token-cheap targeted reads, environment-filter landmine avoided.

skills.name: pega-live-gap-fill
skills.description: When the PDS Neo4j graph, cached summaries, or search results are stale, missing, or ambiguous mid-task, use the Rule Authoring plugin to fetch live truth directly from Pega instead of reporting a gap.

skills.name: pega-cross-environment
skills.description: Compares a rule across the multiple Pega environments PDS MCP's graph spans -- has a defect already been fixed elsewhere, does this rule differ between two environments (drift), what does a working version look like elsewhere. A capability the Rule Authoring plugin cannot offer -- it reaches only one instance.

skills.name: pds-pega-data-access
skills.description: Routing policy for live Pega lookups (rules, cases, branches, data pages) between PDS MCP and the Rule Authoring plugin -- scoped tri-state authority rule, not a blanket policy.

skills.name: pega-app-knowledge
skills.description: Per-application knowledge layer -- check first before re-deriving something already known, write back anything hard-won afterward, into the plugin's own bundled Knowledge/ folder so it ships to the whole team.

skills.name: pega-doc-generator
skills.description: Generates platform-agnostic and/or Pega Blueprint specification documents FROM an existing Pega application, via graph reverse-engineering, explicit-request only.

skills.name: pega-flowaction-migration
skills.description: Analyzes Pega Flow Actions and Case Types for Constellation migration readiness. Resolves dependency chains via PDS MCP, bottom-up multi-agent analysis, outputs a Work-Item Manifest for the Rule Authoring plugin.
